checks.message: NASA task provenance may be internally consistent but is not independently authenticated. Checksums bind local files, not NASA origin. No rasters, returned task layers/dates or pixel QA/scaling are independently verified.

Autocorrelation/independence and AOI-specific calibration remain unverified. In-period climatology estimation induces dependence; reference p-value agreement is arithmetic only. No uncertainty interval, spatial representativeness, causation or scientifically conclusive significance is certified.
Some months have <25% spatial coverage or the fetch flags low coverage. This is descriptive; no observations are dropped and the existing fetch mean-coverage flag is unchanged.
Explicit missing NASA observations are retained as rows; they are distinct from absent CSV rows. Missingness may bias trends.

statistics.ordinary_mk_null: No monotonic trend under independent observations; exact ties, continuity-corrected normal tail.
statistics.p_value_scope: Ordinary MK arithmetic only; independence unverified

result_caveats: Autocorrelation has not yet been corrected; ordinary Mann–Kendall assumes independent observations, so its p-value and significance are provisional.

Monthly climatological means are estimated from available observations in this input period, not an independent reference baseline; short or uneven records can distort anomalies and reduce power. The test uses an asymptotic p-value, which may be unreliable for small samples. A nonsignificant test does not prove stability.

Missing observations are excluded from estimation without interpolation; calendar gaps are preserved for Sen's slope. Missingness and changing spatial coverage can bias trends; upstream pixel QA is assumed and no extra QA cutoff is applied.
NDVI trends describe vegetation index changes, not their causes. Monthly dates are represented by month starts; slopes use anomalies and actual decimal years.
